title: Christmas cake near Oakville or Grantham Farm? 100% eggless, Riverstone
summary:
Christmas lunch in Oakville or Grantham Farm with vegetarian family at the table? Every cake from our Riverstone shop is 100% eggless.

No eggs in the sponge, the buttercream or any of the 15 flavours, so nobody at the table has to ask what is in it.

Order with two days' notice. For a Christmas Eve pickup, order by Tuesday 22 December. A 6-inch serves 6-8 from $39.99; an 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99.

Pickup only, with free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre. Christmas week hours may differ, so confirm your pickup time when you order. 🎄
